entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: This is a fail-closed registration invariant, not a semantic rejection of a query. The production callers request only the math root and existing-plan sites, both registered as mixedFloatOnly in mixedOperandPolicies. lowerMathCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp authorizes the root before invoking its union loader; lowerMathOperand authorizes an already-lowered Mixed operand, and prepareMathValueInput applies the same registered handler when a value consumer needs it. The selected handler narrows float rows after union shadowing; a terminal literal-inverted clamp still checks authorization but does not consume payload. No query can modify the table or choose a different site or mode. Missing entries and unsupported modes are reachable only through internal misuse or authority-test table mutation; changing a production registration or caller requires re-verifying this claim.

guard: default of switch mixedOperandPolicies[key] over [case mixedFloatOnly; default]
